doc.title: Ron Carter interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 17, 1999

title: Chico Hamilton and Eric Dolphy after arriving in New York
summary: Carter's first out-of-town gig was with Chico Hamilton; the band broke up and he and Eric Dolphy stayed in New York.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: You seem to have had a pretty — it wasn’t too long before you were playing with some pretty good people — Chico Hamilton.
Um humm. That was my first gig out of town. I left New York, we left two weeks after coming to New York.
He decided to go west and you stayed?

Eric and I — Eric Dolphy and I stayed in New York, and Chico disbanded, and Chico and the band went to California. The guitar player now is one of the oldest studio guys and the cello player is probably retired, he’s probably close to 85 by now, so the band disbanded.
